device_entry.name: GPIO 距离传感器
device_entry.description: 通过 GPIO 触发/回读实现距离测量的通用传感器接口，常见于超声波测距模块。
device_entry.description_en: A generic GPIO-based distance sensing interface, commonly used with ultrasonic ranging modules.

schema.description: 关闭设备并释放 GPIO 引脚。
schema.description_en: Close the device and release its GPIO pins.

schema.description: 获取/设置最大测量距离。
schema.description_en: Get/set the maximum measurable distance.

schema.description: 获取/设置距离阈值。
schema.description_en: Get/set the distance threshold.

schema.description: 获取当前测得的距离。
schema.description_en: Get the current measured distance.

schema.description: 获取归一化测距值。
schema.description_en: Get the normalized distance value.

schema.description: 获取触发引脚。
schema.description_en: Get the trigger pin.

schema.description: 获取回波引脚。
schema.description_en: Get the echo pin.

schema.description: 获取是否处于设定距离范围内。
schema.description_en: Get whether the sensor is within the configured range.

schema.description: 获取输入引脚的上拉配置。
schema.description_en: Get the pull-up configuration of the input pin.

schema.description: 获取用于平滑测量的队列长度。
schema.description_en: Get the queue length used for smoothing measurements.

schema.description: 获取队列未填满时是否允许返回部分结果。
schema.description_en: Get whether partial results are allowed before the queue is full.

schema.description: 获取/设置激活阈值。
schema.description_en: Get/set the activation threshold.

schema.description: 获取传感器是否处于激活状态。
schema.description_en: Get whether the sensor is active.

schema.description: 检测是否检测到目标线信号。
schema.description_en: Detect whether a target line signal is detected.

schema.description: 设置或读取距离测量充电时间上限参数。
schema.description_en: Set or read the charge-time limit parameter for distance measurement.

schema.description: 等待旋转事件触发后返回状态。
schema.description_en: Wait for a rotation event and return the resulting status.

schema.description: 等待顺时针旋转事件并返回状态。
schema.description_en: Wait for a clockwise rotation event and return status.

schema.description: 等待逆时针旋转事件并返回状态。
schema.description_en: Wait for a counter-clockwise rotation event and return status.

schema.description: 读取或设置旋转步数参数。

schema.description: 读取或设置最大步数限制。

schema.description_en: Configure wrap behavior when step count exceeds limits.
